raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: pysdf
  version: "0.1.9"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: d0639838ec3adcee3499d37290cda217fc1f0834e30a4167da04ae062087fa7b
  patches:
    - search-conda-eigen-prefix.patch

build:
  number: 4
  script:
    - if: win
      then: set "CL=/FIchrono %CL%" && python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    - if: unix
      then: python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - packaging
        - pip
        - pybind11 >=2.5.0
        - python
        - setuptools
        - wheel
  host:
    - eigen >=3.2,<5
    - pip
    - pybind11 >=2.5.0
    - python
    - setuptools
    - wheel
  run:
    - numpy
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pysdf
  - script:
      - pip check
      - python run_test.py
    files:
      recipe:
        - run_test.py
    requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/sxyu/sdf
  repository: https://github.com/sxyu/sdf
  summary: Parallelized triangle mesh --> continuous signed distance field on CPU
  license: BSD-2-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE.txt

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jeongseok-meta
